sources.title: Visa court séjour
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Central African Republic in France
sources.officialityEvidence: The live mission page is hosted on the Central African Foreign Ministry's diplomatie.gouv.cf domain and describes the short-stay application workflow of that mission, without an Israeli-passport rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: envoyez le tout à l'adresse de l'ambassade pour le traitement.

sources.title: Nouvelles tarifications des visas en République du Tchad
sources.publisher: Direction de l'Immigration et de l'Émigration / Sous-Direction e-Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official evisa.td notice is dated 11 May 2026, identifies the Directorate and cites the 2025 entry decree and 2026 visa-categories order. It names an exemption list but does not map Israeli passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: toutes les demandes de visa se font désormais exclusivement en ligne via plateforme officielle evisa.td.

sources.title: Egypt e-Visa Portal: FAQ and named eligibility schedule
sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior of the Arab Republic of Egypt
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Egypt e-Visa portal identifies the Ministry of Interior in its footer, names the eligible nationality schedule, and describes electronic delivery. It does not return a direct Israeli-passport result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The e-Visa is granted to citizens of the countries shown on the site.

sources.title: Visas
sources.publisher: Consulate General of the Arab Republic of Egypt in London
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Egyptian Consulate General visa page directly names Israeli nationals in a competent-authority clearance cohort, gives its timing, and states UK-residence documentation for the London application process.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Processing the clearance request takes at least 8 weeks and may take up to 3 months.

sources.title: Beginning the second phase of the electronic-visa system for regulating foreign entry into Libya
sources.officialityEvidence: LANA's live 29 June 2026 report reproduces the Government of National Unity circular launching E-VISA LIBYA as an approved national electronic-visa platform, but it gives no Israeli-passport eligibility result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: باعتبارهما المنصة الوطنية المعتمدة لإدارة التأشيرات الإلكترونية وتنظيم دخول وإقامة الأجانب في ليبيا.

sources.title: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration: counter entry visa remains in operation
sources.publisher: General Directorate of Passports and Immigration, Ministry of Interior
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Directorate publication of 3 August 2025 states that counter visas remain operative and that approval is handled through Directorate headquarters; it supplies no Israeli-passport scope.
sources.supportingExcerpt: الموافقة على التأشيرة تتم عبر رئاسة الإدارة العامة للجوازات والهجرة.

sources.title: Demande Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Migration and Tunisians Abroad
sources.officialityEvidence: Tunisia's live E-Consulat page identifies the Foreign Ministry, sets a minimum 20-day processing period for visa-subject nationalities, and publishes no nationality schedule or Israeli-passport rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un délai de 20 jours minimum est nécessaire à compter de la date de dépôt de la demande.

conflicts.officialStatus: UK-residence-scoped competent-authority clearance before consular visa issuance for Israeli nationals; clearance takes at least 8 weeks and may take up to 3 months
conflicts.explanation: Egypt's London Consulate directly names Israeli nationals in a prior-clearance cohort and says the later visa issue follows clearance. That conditional, UK-residence-scoped authorization regime is not a nationwide ordinary Israeli-passport visa_required classification.

unresolved.reason: No current accessible Central African government or controlling legal source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to a short-visitor route or issuance timing. The live Paris mission workflow is not a nationality schedule; visa_free is not inferred from any complement.

Chad's current e-Visa notice requires visa applications to use evisa.td and names visa-exempt countries, but it supplies no direct Israeli ordinary-passport eligibility, exemption or issued result. Israel's absence from a named list is not treated as an eVisa or advance-visa complement.

Egypt's live e-Visa portal has a named eligible cohort but no direct Israeli result. Its London Consulate establishes only a UK-residence-scoped prior-clearance route for Israeli nationals, taking at least 8 weeks and up to 3 months before visa issuance. No current nationwide ordinary Israeli-passport visitor classification is established, and the special authorization is not normalized as visa_required.

Libya's current government circular confirms E-VISA LIBYA as a national platform, but no accessible current Libyan primary source directly maps an ordinary Israeli passport to eligibility, prohibition, another visitor route or issuance timing. Platform availability or omission is not treated as evisa evidence.

Sudan's Passport Directorate confirms that counter visas remain operative and require headquarters approval, but no accessible current Sudanese authority maps an ordinary Israeli passport to eligibility, prior authorization, a prohibition, or an actual visitor issuance result. The generic process is not a passport-specific classification.

Tunisia's current E-Consulat states a process and minimum timing for unspecified visa-subject nationalities, but publishes no current nationality schedule, Israeli-passport rule, exemption, special authorization or actual issuance result. The fallback advance-visa label is therefore unverified rather than inferred from a general process.
